projectDescription: A Cookie Clicker addon that provides Payback Period calculations, color-coded building/upgrade rankings, statistics panels, timers, tooltips, and notifications to help players optimize their game without acting as a cheat tool.
keyFeatures: Payback Period (PP) index for all buildings and upgrades
Color-coded building and upgrade rankings (blue, green, yellow, orange, red, purple, gray)
Bottom bar showing bonus income, PP, and time-left per building
Timer bar for golden cookies, season popups, Frenzy/Clot/Click Frenzy, and autosave
Enhanced tooltips for buildings, upgrades, grimoire, pantheon gods, garden plots, stock market, and sugar lumps
Statistics page extension with Lucky/Chain cookie values, wrinkler rewards, prestige info, and achievement tracking
Sound and browser notifications for golden cookies, season popups, wrinklers, garden ticks, and full magic meter
Customizable number notation (short scale, scientific, engineering, metric)
Favicon updates to reflect golden or wrath cookie presence
CookieMonsterData global object exposing PP and colour data to other addons
Building lock buttons and section hide buttons
Rigidel mode and bulk-buy blocking for optimized pantheon play
publicApiSurface: window.CookieMonsterData.Objects1 — cached PP/colour/bonus data for buy-1 buildings
window.CookieMonsterData.Objects10 — cached PP/colour/bonus data for buy-10 buildings
window.CookieMonsterData.Objects100 — cached PP/colour/bonus data for buy-100 buildings
window.CookieMonsterData.Upgrades — cached PP/colour data for all upgrades
Game.mods.cookieMonsterFramework.saveData.cookieMonsterMod.settings — all user settings object
Game.registerMod('CookieMonster', { init, load, save }) — Cookie Clicker Mod API registration
settings.CPSMode — toggle current vs average CPS for calculations
settings.Scale — number notation scale (metric, short scale, scientific, engineering)
settings.BuildColour — toggle color-coding for buildings
settings.UpBarColour — toggle color-coding and bar for upgrades
settings.BotBar — toggle bottom bar display
settings.TimerBar — toggle timer bar display
settings.GCTimer — toggle golden cookie countdown timer
settings.Favicon — toggle favicon updates
settings.Stats — toggle Cookie Monster statistics page extension
settings.MissingUpgrades — show missing upgrades in statistics
settings.MissingAchievements — show missing achievements in statistics
settings.GCNotification / GCFlash / GCSound — golden cookie notification controls
settings.WrinklerButtons — toggle wrinkler pop buttons
settings.PPRigidelMode — ignore buy-1 options for Rigidel pantheon god strategy
